title: RGB and VIS/NIR Hyperspectral Imaging Data for 90 Rice Seed Varieties
authors: Vu, Hai and Tachtatzis, Christos and Murray, Paul and Harle, David and Dao, Trung-Kien and Andonovic, Ivan and Marshall, Stephen and Fabiyi, Samson Damilola
protocol_scope: 90 varieties; two bundles of 48; nine acquisition batches
finding: Paired RGB/HSI, white/dark references and chessboard documented. Record explains one NDC1 reacquisition.
local_decision: Acquisition authority; do not infer biological lot diversity or pixel registration from filenames.

title: Varietal Classification of Rice Seeds Using RGB and Hyperspectral Images
authors: Fabiyi, Samson Damilola and others
protocol_scope: RVHID90; 4:1 train/test; acquisition-disjoint protocol not specified in inspected methods
finding: RGB morphology plus HSI LDA features and RF; 78.27% F1 for90. Ratio and RF size selected in preliminary analysis.
local_decision: Closest original baseline; fusion already established. No numeric comparison with grouped v5 without matched replication.

title: Significance of Morphological Features in Rice Variety Classification Using Hyperspectral Imaging
authors: Filipović, Vladan and Panić, Marko and Brdar, Sanja and Brkljač, Branko
access: primary proceedings metadata; full methods not obtained
finding: Identity verified; the 85.65% F1 quoted by later papers was not independently verified from the original full paper.
local_decision: Retrieve full protocol before faithful replication; do not propagate secondary attribution as primary evidence.

title: Ensemble deep learning for high-precision classification of 90 rice seed varieties from hyperspectral images
authors: Taheri, Amir Masoud and Ebrahimnezhad, Hossein and Sedaaghi, Mohammadhossein
venue: Journal of Ambient Intelligence and Humanized Computing 15:2883–2899
protocol_scope: 90 rice varieties; RGB plus15 selected HSI bands; split unverified
finding: Reports overall precision92.73–96.17%, not a directly comparable grouped macro-F1.
local_decision: Priority comparator; request/retrieve full text through normal access before protocol-level claims. Do not assert proven leakage.

title: Classification of maize seed hyperspectral images based on variable-depth convolutional kernels
authors: Hu, Yating and Zhang, Hongchen and Li, Changming and Su, Qianfu and Wang, Wei
protocol_scope: Main8 maize classes,800 seeds,4:1; RVHID90 auxiliary test without reconstructible rice split IDs
finding: Rice Table4 reports97.78% accuracy and97.67% F1. Main maize kernel-depth selection examines test results. Rice table has inconsistent baseline attributions.
local_decision: Serious high-score comparator; requires protocol reconstruction, not dismissal or direct leaderboard ordering.

title: 基于深度学习的稻谷品种识别方法研究 [Research on rice variety recognition based on deep learning; translated title]
authors: 黄丽 and 陈亦鲜 and 汪华章 and 熊玉文
venue: Journal of Southwest Minzu University (Natural Science Edition), online 2026-08-06
identifier: publisher online record; DOI not displayed
protocol_scope: 90 varieties; paired single kernels; split and exact dataset identity not verified from abstract
finding: 2D RGB and3D HSI branches with adaptive gated fusion;93.50% reported accuracy.
local_decision: Direct novelty warning: generic gated multimodal rice network is already described; obtain full methods before numerical comparison.

title: ClusterRiceNet: A novel rice seed variety classification network based on hyperspectral imaging and spectral band clustering
authors: Yu, Shuang and Wang, Zikang and Wang, Zeyu and Liu, Mingyi and Zhan, Yongze and Song, Shaozong and Wang, Zhongjie
protocol_scope: Two rice datasets with6 and7 varieties; acquisition support not verified
finding: Band clustering plus local feature extraction and Swin-based global features.
local_decision: Spectral grouping/local-global combination not novel by itself; small-class scores do not establish90-class transfer.

title: RiceSeedNet: Rice seed variety identification using deep neural network
authors: Rajalakshmi, R. and others
venue: Journal of Agriculture and Food Research 16:101062
protocol_scope: 13 local RGB rice varieties;13000 images; second8-class grain dataset; seed data confidential
finding: ViT-based classifier reports97% and99% on separate datasets.
local_decision: RGB transformer baseline rationale; not RVHID90 or new-session evidence. Avoid reusing RiceSeedNet name for a novel model.

title: SpectralFormer: Rethinking Hyperspectral Image Classification With Transformers
authors: Hong, Danfeng and Han, Zhu and Yao, Jing and Gao, Lianru and Zhang, Bing and Plaza, Antonio and Chanussot, Jocelyn
finding: Local spectral groups and cross-layer connections support spectral sequence learning.
local_decision: Representative transformer comparator; physical wavelength/gap handling and seed-level splits still require adaptation.

title: MambaHSI: Spatial-Spectral Mamba for Hyperspectral Image Classification
authors: Li, Yapeng and Luo, Yong and Zhang, Lefei and Wang, Zengmao and Du, Bo
finding: State-space approach aims at efficient long-range spatial and spectral dependencies.
local_decision: Low priority on small individual seeds unless profiling shows sequence cost binding; no automatic advantage from linear asymptotics.

title: Spectral-Spatial Mamba for Hyperspectral Image Classification
authors: Huang, Lingbo and Chen, Yushi and He, Xin
finding: Spatial-spectral state-space representation.
local_decision: Same mechanism gate as MambaHSI; a representative is enough, not a large Mamba sweep.

title: HyperSIGMA: Hyperspectral Intelligence Comprehension Foundation Model
authors: Wang, Di and others
venue: Author preprint; official repository reports TPAMI2025 acceptance
access: official author repository and preprint metadata
finding: Large spectral/spatial foundation model.
local_decision: Transfer candidate after compact frozen spectral probe; confirm checkpoint, compute, license and spectrum coverage.

title: HyperFree: A Channel-adaptive and Tuning-free Foundation Model for Hyperspectral Remote Sensing Imagery
authors: Li, Jingtao and Liu, Yingyi and Wang, Xinyu and Peng, Yunning and Sun, Chen and Wang, Shaoyu and Sun, Zhendong and Ke, Tian and Jiang, Xiao and Lu, Tangwei and Zhao, Anran and Zhong, Yanfei
access: author abstract; CVPR page fetch blocked
protocol_scope: 5 tasks/11 remote-sensing datasets; wavelength dictionary0.4–2.5 micrometers
finding: Channel-adaptive embedding and prompting accommodate varied HSI inputs.
local_decision: Does not cover all383-nm input by default; segmentation/prompt transfer differs from90-way seed recognition.

title: HyperSL: A Spectral Foundation Model for Hyperspectral Image Interpretation
authors: Kong, Weili and Liu, Baisen and Bi, Xiaojun and Yu, Changdong and Li, Xinyao and Chen, Yushi
finding: Universal spectral model and released weights support a frozen feature probe.
local_decision: Highest-priority HSI transfer probe; exact input range, gaps, license and overlap must be checked before use.

title: HyperFM: An Efficient Hyperspectral Foundation Model with Spectral Grouping
authors: Tushar, Zahid Hassan and Purushotham, Sanjay
finding: Efficient grouped spectral foundation model in a substantially different physical domain.
local_decision: Watchlist, low seed priority; do not conflate CVPR Findings with main track or atmospheric retrieval with seed recognition.

title: Cross-Domain Transfer of Hyperspectral Foundation Models
authors: Theisen, Nick and Neubert, Peer
protocol_scope: Remote-to-proximal transfer on HS3-Bench semantic segmentation
finding: Existing HSI pretraining can transfer across sensing domains in the reported benchmark.
local_decision: Supports a low-cost frozen probe, not a prediction of rice gains.

title: Deep Sets
authors: Zaheer, Manzil and Kottur, Satwik and Ravanbakhsh, Siamak and Poczos, Barnabas and Salakhutdinov, Ruslan and Smola, Alexander
finding: Shared element encoding and symmetric aggregation have a theoretical representation basis under stated assumptions.
local_decision: Pixel bags are principled controls for distributional information; pure sets lose spatial geometry.

title: Attention-based Deep Multiple Instance Learning
authors: Ilse, Maximilian and Tomczak, Jakub and Welling, Max
protocol_scope: Bag labels; benchmark and histopathology tasks
finding: Learned permutation-invariant attention aggregation.
local_decision: Small regional/pixel aggregator candidate; attention weights are not proof of biological causality.

title: Set Transformer: A Framework for Attention-based Permutation-Invariant Neural Networks
authors: Lee, Juho and Lee, Yoonho and Kim, Jungtaek and Kosiorek, Adam and Choi, Seungjin and Teh, Yee Whye
finding: Adds interactions while preserving permutation invariance.
local_decision: Use only if simple pooling loses important distribution interactions; low token count makes elaborate scaling machinery unnecessary.

title: DINOv3
authors: Siméoni, Oriane and others
finding: Strong frozen visual representations from pretraining.
local_decision: Probe masked high-resolution RGB; pin released model and license. No seed-specific performance promised.

title: A ConvNet for the 2020s
authors: Liu, Zhuang and Mao, Hanzi and Wu, Chao-Yuan and Feichtenhofer, Christoph and Darrell, Trevor and Xie, Saining
finding: Modernized convolutions compete strongly with transformer backbones.
local_decision: Conventional pretrained RGB control; avoids assuming that a transformer is required.

title: Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners
authors: He, Kaiming and Chen, Xinlei and Xie, Saining and Li, Yanghao and Dollár, Piotr and Girshick, Ross
finding: Masked reconstruction can produce transferable representations.
local_decision: Optional train-only spectral pretraining after frozen probes; reconstruction can preserve acquisition nuisances and all-scan pretraining changes protocol.

title: What Makes Training Multi-Modal Classification Networks Hard?
authors: Wang, Weiyao and Tran, Du and Feiszli, Matt
finding: Different overfitting/generalization rates can make naive joint training worse than a unimodal model.
local_decision: Measure branch degradation and compare late fusion before sophisticated fusion.

title: Balanced Multimodal Learning via On-the-Fly Gradient Modulation
authors: Peng, Xiaokang and Wei, Yake and Deng, Andong and Wang, Dong and Hu, Di
finding: Modulates modality learning when one dominates optimization.
local_decision: Conditional mechanism only after measured gradient/branch failure; not an obligatory module.

title: In Search of Lost Domain Generalization
authors: Gulrajani, Ishaan and Lopez-Paz, David
protocol_scope: Multi-domain image benchmarks with controlled model selection
finding: Properly selected ERM is a strong baseline; selection procedure is part of the algorithm.
local_decision: Keep strong ERM and declared calibration support; do not treat fancy DG as guaranteed.

title: Domain-Adversarial Training of Neural Networks
authors: Ganin, Yaroslav and Ustinova, Evgeniya and Ajakan, Hana and Germain, Pascal and Larochelle, Hugo and Laviolette, François and Marchand, Mario and Lempitsky, Victor
protocol_scope: Source labeled and target unlabeled adaptation
finding: Gradient reversal encourages domain-indiscriminate features.
local_decision: Not automatically inductive DG. Class/session-confounded label marginals make unconditional alignment problematic here.

title: Distributionally Robust Neural Networks for Group Shifts: On the Importance of Regularization for Worst-Case Generalization
authors: Sagawa, Shiori and Koh, Pang Wei and Hashimoto, Tatsunori B. and Liang, Percy
protocol_scope: Group robustness with observed group structure
finding: Regularization matters for worst-group generalization.
local_decision: Reweight observed groups as a control on new crossed data; cannot recover unobserved class-session support.

title: Last Layer Re-Training is Sufficient for Robustness to Spurious Correlations
authors: Kirichenko, Polina and Izmailov, Pavel and Wilson, Andrew Gordon
finding: Strong representations can support inexpensive last-layer robustness correction.
local_decision: Useful with genuinely balanced development acquisitions; current calib is not such a set.

title: Fundamental Limits and Tradeoffs in Invariant Representation Learning
authors: Zhao, Han and Dan, Chen and Aragam, Bryon and Jaakkola, Tommi S. and Gordon, Geoffrey J. and Ravikumar, Pradeep
finding: Invariant representations can face unavoidable accuracy tradeoffs under their distributions.
local_decision: Supports caution; S19 supplies its own simpler deterministic S=g(Y) argument rather than importing a bound without assumptions.

title: Domain Generalization with MixStyle
authors: Zhou, Kaiyang and Yang, Yongxin and Qiao, Yu and Xiang, Tao
finding: Mixes instance feature statistics to diversify styles.
local_decision: S14 tested masked local variant and failed; revise only if a measured nuisance mechanism differs.

title: Spectral Property-Driven Data Augmentation for Hyperspectral Single-Source Domain Generalization
authors: Chen, Taiqin and Wang, Yifeng and Feng, Xiaochen and Zhu, Zhilin and Sha, Hao and Li, Yingjian and Zhang, Yongbing
finding: Spectral resampling/mixing and spatial-property constraints improve reported remote benchmarks.
local_decision: Compare only transformations physically valid for measured intervals; no interpolation through the saturated hole.

title: Convolutional neural networks in Vis–NIR chemometrics: From contradiction to conditional design
authors: Passos, Dário
finding: Reviews conditional utility of CNN inductive biases and validation.
local_decision: Supports design matched to data; a review is not new empirical evidence for this dataset.

title: On Over-fitting in Model Selection and Subsequent Selection Bias in Performance Evaluation
authors: Cawley, Gavin C. and Talbot, Nicola L. C.
finding: Selection overfitting can bias performance evaluation.
local_decision: Need final locked acquisitions after repeated adaptive benchmark development.

title: TabPFN-3.5: Technical Report
authors: Jäger, Benjamin and Erickson, Nick and Grinsztajn, Léo and others
finding: Newest verified report extends beyond TabPFN-3; claims are authors benchmark results.
local_decision: Optional descriptor baseline after checking90-class support, implementation availability, license and memory. No assumed free CPU route.

title: FusedNet Model for Varietal Classification of Rice Seeds
authors: Tyagi, Nitin and Khandelwal, Yash and Goyal, Pratham and Asati, Yash and Raman, Balasubramanian and Gupta, Indra and Garg, Neerja
finding: SVM over spatial/spectral features plus RGB ResNet50 ensemble;87.27% accuracy,86.87% average F1.
local_decision: Direct simple-fusion comparator. Corrects later bibliographic misquoting of venue/pages; cannot compare to grouped v5 numerically.

title: Spectral Band Attention Networks for Efficient Multi-Feature Fusion in Hyperspectral and RGB Data with Ensemble Deep Learning Networks
authors: Tyagi, Nitin and Porwal, Sarvagya and Singh, Pradeep and Raman, Balasubramanian and Garg, Neerja
protocol_scope: 96 Indian wheat varieties;900–1700nm; acquisition protocol unverified
finding: Attention-selected25 bands and RGB/deep ensemble/SVM;95.75% accuracy.
local_decision: Relevant seed fusion/band novelty precedent, not rice performance evidence. Data-availability text conflicts with abstract; obtain actual dataset access before planning replication.

title: Identification of Soybean Varieties Using Hyperspectral Imaging Coupled with Convolutional Neural Network
authors: Zhu, Susu and Zhou, Lei and Zhang, Chu and Bao, Yidan and Wu, Baohua and Chu, Hangjian and Yu, Yue and He, Yong and Feng, Lei
access: publisher PDF indexed excerpt; direct fetch unavailable
protocol_scope: Soybean pixel-wise spectral CNN; split details not independently checked
finding: Uses pixel-level spectra for seed variety recognition with limited seed samples.
local_decision: Relevant distribution encoder precedent; keep all pixels of one kernel together and avoid treating pixels as independent seeds.

title: Identification of the variety of maize seeds based on hyperspectral images coupled with convolutional neural networks and subregional voting
authors: Zhou, Q. and Huang, W. and Tian, X. and Yang, Y. and Liang, D.
venue: Journal of the Science of Food and Agriculture101:4532–4542
protocol_scope: Six normal and six sweet maize varieties; seed subregions; split unverified
finding: Spectral preprocessing and subregion CNN predictions combined by voting.
local_decision: Regional seed modeling already exists; our evidence must establish geometry/transfer gains rather than claim first regional pooling.

title: HybridSN: Exploring 3D-2D CNN Feature Hierarchy for Hyperspectral Image Classification
authors: Roy, Swalpa Kumar and Krishna, Gopal and Dubey, Shiv Ram and Chaudhuri, Bidyut B.
venue: IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters; online2019
finding: 3D spectral-spatial convolution followed by2D spatial convolution.
local_decision: Core architectural precedent to SeedNet spatial path; efficient hybrid CNN is not new by itself.
